records.context: Two wiring details are load-bearing; both are the same contract :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` documents, and this function used to get them wrong:
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.worker.make_stream_thread#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Two wiring details are load-bearing; both are the same contract :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` documents, and this function used to get them wrong:
records.translation: 有两处连接细节至关重要；二者与 :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` 所记录的约定相同，而本函数过去曾把它们弄错：

records.context: There is deliberately **no** ``worker.deleteLater``. The worker's affinity is the background execution unit, so a deferred delete is posted into a loop that is stopping, while the panel drops the object's last Python reference from the main GUI execution path — two owners, one object. ``bridge.make_thread``'s ownership essay records the gdb trace (``QThread -> sendPostedEvents -> ~QObject -> Sbk_GetPyOverride``) and the measurement: 3 crashes in 8 executions. A PySide6 object built in Python is already owned by Python; ``ConsolePanel``/``AIChatPanel`` hold it in ``_retired`` until the independent execution path has exited and free it there, on the independent execution path that holds it.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.worker.make_stream_thread#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: There is deliberately **no** ``worker.deleteLater``. The worker's affinity is the worker thread, so a deferred delete is posted into a loop that is stopping, while the panel drops the object's last Python reference from the GUI thread — two owners, one object. ``bridge.make_thread``'s ownership essay records the gdb trace (``QThread -> sendPostedEvents -> ~QObject -> Sbk_GetPyOverride``) and the measurement: 3 crashes in 8 runs. A PySide6 object built in Python is already owned by Python; ``ConsolePanel``/``AIChatPanel`` hold it in ``_retired`` until the thread has exited and free it there, on the thread that holds it.
records.translation: 这里刻意 **没有** ``worker.deleteLater``。工作对象的线程亲和性属于工作线程，因此延迟删除会被投递到一个正在停止的事件循环中，而面板又在 GUI 线程上释放该对象的最后一个 Python 引用 — 一个对象，两个所有者。``bridge.make_thread`` 中关于所有权的说明记录了 gdb 跟踪（``QThread -> sendPostedEvents -> ~QObject -> Sbk_GetPyOverride``）和测量结果：8 次运行中崩溃 3 次。在 Python 中创建的 PySide6 对象本就归 Python 所有；``ConsolePanel``/``AIChatPanel`` 将其保存在 ``_retired`` 中，直到线程退出后，再在持有它的线程上释放。

records.source: These are not a procedural sky of point stars — ``cell.png``'s cyan core fills most of the frame and measures 0.236 in the brightest text-line-sized window, which is far too bright to put white-on-nothing text over. So each master is dimmed at build time by a factor solved from the palette: :func:`spacr.qt.theme.max_background_luma` returns the brightest a bare window background may be before some role that gets painted straight onto it (``fg``, ``fg_muted``, ``accent``, ``fg_dim``, the status hues) drops below its WCAG minimum, and :func:`solve_dim` scales the image in linear light until the brightest :data:`TEXT_WINDOW`-sized region lands on that number less :data:`SAFETY_MARGIN`.
records.translation: 这些图像并不是由点状星星组成的程序化星空 — ``cell.png`` 的青色核心几乎占满画面，在与一行文字大小相当的最亮窗口中测得 0.236，远远太亮，无法在其上直接放置白色文字。因此每张母图在构建时都会按一个由调色板求出的系数调暗：:func:`spacr.qt.theme.max_background_luma` 返回裸窗口背景所允许的最高亮度，超过该值时直接绘制在其上的某个角色（``fg``、``fg_muted``、``accent``、``fg_dim``、各状态色调）就会低于其 WCAG 最低要求；:func:`solve_dim` 在线性光空间中缩放图像，直到最亮的 :data:`TEXT_WINDOW` 大小区域落在该数值减去 :data:`SAFETY_MARGIN` 处。

Five later features build on the layer model — ROI shapes read by Measure, a counting points layer, a label brush with timelapse track curation, orthogonal views with dimension sliders, and a synchronised comparison grid — and every one of them is a change to the model with a small widget on top. records.context: :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview._ZoomView` is the right answer when the thing being shown is a finished pixmap: it scales what it was given. Here the zoom is a property of the world, not of the picture — zooming in means :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.zoomed` and a fresh render at the new resolution, which is how the labels layer stays crisp at 8× and how the orthogonal-view item gets its slice sliders for free. So the canvas owns a :class:`~spacr.layers.Canvas` and paints; the array→pixmap step still goes through :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.numpy_to_qpixmap`, and file loading through :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.load_preview_image`, rather than growing a third copy of either.

records.context: ``clear VRAM`` ``torch.cuda.empty_cache()``, which hands the CUDA driver back the blocks torch reserved and is no longer using, plus releasing any model reference spaCR itself is holding (:data:`MODEL_RELEASERS`). **It cannot reclaim another process's VRAM** — no process can — and it cannot free a tensor an executing spaCR job is still using, which is the point rather than a limitation.
records.label: spacr.qt.resource_cleanup#10

records.source: ``clear VRAM`` ``torch.cuda.empty_cache()``, which hands the CUDA driver back the blocks torch reserved and is no longer using, plus releasing any model reference spaCR itself is holding (:data:`MODEL_RELEASERS`). **It cannot reclaim another process's VRAM** — no process can — and it cannot free a tensor a running spaCR job is still using, which is the point rather than a limitation.
records.translation: ``clear VRAM`` ``torch.cuda.empty_cache()``，它把 torch 保留但已不再使用的内存块交还给 CUDA 驱动，同时释放 spaCR 自身持有的任何模型引用（:data:`MODEL_RELEASERS`）。**它无法回收其他进程的 VRAM** — 任何进程都做不到 — 也无法释放正在运行的 spaCR 任务仍在使用的张量，这正是其目的，而不是局限。

records.context: ``clear CPU`` Releases parked background execution units that have since exited (:func:`spacr.qt.bridge.prune_parked_threads`), lets Qt's global pool retire its idle independent execution paths, and lowers spaCR's own library worker-count limits (torch, OpenCV) to a floor. It retires *idle* capacity only: work that is queued or executing is left exactly where it is.
records.label: spacr.qt.resource_cleanup#11
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``clear CPU`` Releases parked worker threads that have since exited (:func:`spacr.qt.bridge.prune_parked_threads`), lets Qt's global pool retire its idle threads, and lowers spaCR's own library thread counts (torch, OpenCV) to a floor. It retires *idle* capacity only: work that is queued or running is left exactly where it is.
records.translation: ``clear CPU`` 释放已退出的暂存工作线程（:func:`spacr.qt.bridge.prune_parked_threads`），让 Qt 的全局线程池回收空闲线程，并将 spaCR 自身各库的线程数（torch、OpenCV）降到下限。它只回收 *空闲* 的容量：排队中或运行中的工作保持原样。

records.context: Every number is measured before and after by the same function, and :class:`Reclaim` carries both endpoints so a caller can show the subtraction rather than an estimate. records.source: Every number is measured before and after by the same function, and :class:`Reclaim` carries both endpoints so a caller can show the subtraction rather than an estimate. records.context: The reconciliation is that the two rules are about different things. The exposure anchor is about a *pixel with nothing in it*; the WCAG limit is about the mean over a **region the size of a line of text** (:data:`spacr.qt.imagery.TEXT_WINDOW`), which is the point :mod:`spacr.qt.imagery` already makes about photographs — every photograph has a white pixel somewhere and it is a bright *patch* that makes a caption unreadable. A 3 px star inside a 202x48 px text window moves that window's mean by a quarter of one per cent; the whole starfield measured on its own comes to 0.0007-0.0067, i.e. 1-11 % of the limit. A 207 px sun disc fills the window completely and cannot.

The exposure anchor is about a *pixel with nothing in it*; the WCAG limit is about the mean over a **region the size of a line of text** (:data:`spacr.qt.imagery.TEXT_WINDOW`), which is the point :mod:`spacr.qt.imagery` already makes about photographs — every photograph has a white pixel somewhere and it is a bright *patch* that makes a caption unreadable. A 3 px star inside a 202x48 px text window moves that window's mean by a quarter of one per cent; the whole starfield measured on its own comes to 0.0007-0.0067, i.e. 1-11 % of the limit. A 207 px sun disc fills the window completely and cannot.
records.translation: 协调的关键在于这两条规则针对的是不同的东西。曝光锚点针对的是 *空无一物的像素*；WCAG 上限针对的是 **一行文字大小的区域**（:data:`spacr.qt.imagery.TEXT_WINDOW`）上的平均值，这也正是 :mod:`spacr.qt.imagery` 对照片已经阐明的观点 — 每张照片某处都有白色像素，让说明文字无法阅读的是明亮的 *斑块*。在 202x48 px 的文字窗口内，一颗 3 px 的星星只会让该窗口的平均值变化百分之零点二五；单独测量整个星空，结果为 0.0007-0.0067，即上限的 1-11 %。而一个 207 px 的太阳圆盘会完全填满窗口，无法满足上限。

records.context: So the exposure anchor is kept exactly as it was — the sky background is unchanged, to the byte — and the limit is enforced where it is actually violated, by compressing the highlights of the **smooth** layers only (:func:`_compress_highlights`, applied to nebula + galaxy + sun + bloom, never to the starfield). The sun therefore does get noticeably darker, which is the accepted cost; the galaxy is barely touched because it was never the offender; the stars keep white cores and diffraction spikes. :func:`_enforce_legibility` then measures the finished frame with the same :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.brightest_window` used on the photographs and applies whatever residual dim is left, so the guarantee is a measurement and not an argument.
records.label: spacr.qt.space#17
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: So the exposure anchor is kept exactly as it was — the sky background is unchanged, to the byte — and the limit is enforced where it is actually violated, by compressing the highlights of the **smooth** layers only (:func:`_compress_highlights`, applied to nebula + galaxy + sun + bloom, never to the starfield). The sun therefore does get noticeably darker, which is the accepted cost; the galaxy is barely touched because it was never the offender; the stars keep white cores and diffraction spikes. :func:`_enforce_legibility` then measures the finished frame with the same :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.brightest_window` used on the photographs and applies whatever residual dim is left, so the guarantee is a measurement and not an argument.
records.translation: 因此曝光锚点完全保持原样 — 天空背景逐字节不变 — 而上限在实际被违反的地方执行，方法是只压缩 **平滑** 图层的高光（:func:`_compress_highlights`，作用于星云 + 星系 + 太阳 + 辉光，从不作用于星空）。因此太阳确实会明显变暗，这是可以接受的代价；星系几乎不受影响，因为它从来不是问题所在；星星保留白色核心和衍射星芒。随后 :func:`_enforce_legibility` 使用与照片相同的 :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.brightest_window` 测量最终画面，并施加剩余所需的调暗，因此这一保证是测量结果，而不是推论。

records.source: ``QToolTip`` only paints. It renders rich text and nothing inside it can be clicked, hovered or focused, so a link drawn in it cannot be pressed. What works is a frameless tooltip-styled ``QLabel`` with ``Qt.TextBrowserInteraction``: its ``linkActivated`` carries the href, so ``api`` opens the documentation and ``install`` opens the offer.
records.translation: ``QToolTip`` 只负责绘制。它渲染富文本，但其中的任何内容都不能被点击、悬停或获得焦点，因此绘制在其中的链接无法按下。可行的做法是使用一个无边框、具有工具提示样式的 ``QLabel``，并设置 ``Qt.TextBrowserInteraction``：其 ``linkActivated`` 携带 href，于是 ``api`` 打开文档，``install`` 打开安装提议。

records.context: An interactive tooltip has three requirements, handled here as follows:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.availability_panel#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: An interactive tooltip has three requirements, handled here as follows:
records.translation: 交互式工具提示有三项要求，本模块的处理方式如下：

records.context: It must not disappear while the pointer moves toward it. The pointer has to cross the gap between the row and the panel, and a plain leave-event dismissal closes it mid-journey, which makes the Install link unreachable. The hide is a timer, the timer is cancelled on entry, and while it is pending the cursor is checked against the corridor -- the union of the anchor's rectangle and the panel's -- so travelling through the gap re-arms the timer instead of firing it. See :meth:`AvailabilityPanel. _maybe_hide`.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.availability_panel#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: It must not disappear while the pointer moves toward it. The pointer has to cross the gap between the row and the panel, and a plain leave-event dismissal closes it mid-journey, which makes the Install link unreachable. The hide is a timer, the timer is cancelled on entry, and while it is pending the cursor is checked against the corridor -- the union of the anchor's rectangle and the panel's -- so travelling through the gap re-arms the timer instead of firing it. See :meth:`AvailabilityPanel. _maybe_hide`.
records.translation: 在指针向它移动时不得消失。指针必须穿过行与面板之间的间隙，而简单的离开事件关闭会在途中就关掉面板，使 Install 链接无法到达。隐藏由计时器触发，进入面板时取消计时器；在计时器等待期间，会检查光标是否位于通道内 -- 即锚点矩形与面板矩形的并集 -- 因此穿过间隙会重新启动计时器，而不是触发它。参见 :meth:`AvailabilityPanel. _maybe_hide`。

records.translation: 必须可以关闭。按 Escape、在面板外任意位置单击，以及远离通道，都会关闭它。

records.context: It must be reachable by keyboard, and that cannot be inherited from the row because the row is disabled. :meth:`AvailabilityPanel.open_for` is the explicit keyboard route: it shows the panel activated with the first link focused, Up/Down move between the unavailable entries, Escape closes it and returns focus to wherever it came from. A keyboard-opened panel is pinned and never closes on a hover timer.

records.translation: 必须可以通过键盘到达，而这一点无法从行继承，因为该行已被禁用。:meth:`AvailabilityPanel.open_for` 是明确的键盘入口：它以激活状态显示面板并使第一个链接获得焦点，Up/Down 在不可用条目之间移动，Escape 关闭面板并把焦点还给原来的位置。通过键盘打开的面板处于固定状态，绝不会因悬停计时器而关闭。

records.source: The panel is a process-wide singleton with two callers. A plain ``connect`` on every show accumulates receivers, so one press would eventually run the regression picker's install and the Image UMAP's; a plain ``disconnect()`` warns when nothing is connected yet. Holding the current slot and replacing it does neither. A previous slot bound to a widget that has since been deleted is simply dropped.
records.translation: 该面板是有两个调用方的进程范围单例。每次显示时简单地 ``connect`` 会累积接收者，最终一次按下会同时运行回归选择器和 Image UMAP 的安装；简单地 ``disconnect()`` 则会在尚未连接任何对象时发出警告。保存当前槽并替换它，两种问题都不会出现。若之前的槽绑定到一个已被删除的部件，则直接丢弃。

records.context: Rank per-object measurements by class-separation performance.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_rank#0
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Rank per-object measurements by class-separation performance.
records.translation: 按类别区分性能对逐对象测量值进行排序。

records.context: The default statistic is the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC), computed from the Mann–Whitney U statistic. Results are reported as the unit-free separation ``|2·AUC − 1|`` in ``[0, 1]`` together with the direction of the class difference. AUC is rank based and therefore invariant under monotonic transformations; it does not require normality, equal variance or symmetry. These properties allow measurements with different units and distributions to be compared in one ranking.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_rank#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The default statistic is the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC), computed from the Mann–Whitney U statistic. Results are reported as the unit-free separation ``|2·AUC − 1|`` in ``[0, 1]`` together with the direction of the class difference. AUC is rank based and therefore invariant under monotonic transformations; it does not require normality, equal variance or symmetry. These properties allow measurements with different units and distributions to be compared in one ranking.
records.translation: 默认统计量是受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC），由 Mann–Whitney U 统计量计算得出。结果以无单位的区分度 ``|2·AUC − 1|`` 报告，取值位于 ``[0, 1]`` 内，并附带类别差异的方向。AUC 基于秩，因此在单调变换下保持不变；它不要求正态性、方差齐性或对称性。这些性质使单位和分布各不相同的测量值能够在同一排名中比较。

records.context: AUC represents the probability that a randomly selected object from one class has a higher value than a randomly selected object from the other class. It detects stochastic ordering but can miss distribution-shape differences. For example, classes with the same centre but different spread can have an AUC of 0.5 despite differing distributions. The Kolmogorov–Smirnov (KS) statistic is therefore computed for every feature. A high KS statistic combined with AUC near 0.5 sets :attr:`FeatureScore.is_shape_not_shift`.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_rank#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: AUC represents the probability that a randomly selected object from one class has a higher value than a randomly selected object from the other class. It detects stochastic ordering but can miss distribution-shape differences. For example, classes with the same centre but different spread can have an AUC of 0.5 despite differing distributions. The Kolmogorov–Smirnov (KS) statistic is therefore computed for every feature. A high KS statistic combined with AUC near 0.5 sets :attr:`FeatureScore.is_shape_not_shift`.
records.translation: AUC 表示从一个类别中随机选取的对象，其值高于从另一类别中随机选取的对象的概率。它能检测随机序关系，但可能漏掉分布形状的差异。例如，中心相同但离散程度不同的类别，尽管分布不同，AUC 仍可能为 0.5。因此会为每个特征计算 Kolmogorov–Smirnov（KS）统计量。KS 统计量高而 AUC 接近 0.5 时，会设置 :attr:`FeatureScore.is_shape_not_shift`。

records.source: :attr:`ExplorerSpec.n_permutations` enables a family-wise permutation calibration. Class labels are permuted, the complete ranking is recomputed and the maximum score from each permutation is retained. The 95th percentile of these maxima is returned as :attr:`ExplorerResult.null_threshold`. Calibration uses a seeded subsample of at most :data:`NULL_MAX_ROWS` rows and is disabled by default because computation scales with the number of permutations.
records.translation: :attr:`ExplorerSpec.n_permutations` 启用族系误差置换校准。对类别标签进行置换，重新计算完整排名，并保留每次置换的最高分。这些最大值的第 95 百分位数作为 :attr:`ExplorerResult.null_threshold` 返回。校准使用一个带种子、最多 :data:`NULL_MAX_ROWS` 行的子样本，默认禁用，因为计算量随置换次数增加。

records.context: Return True after writing the PNG displayed by the GUI. Failure of the *related PDF* does not return False. Callers interpret False as "no pixmap, no thumbnail", which would incorrectly remove the figure. Instead, log a warning. :meth:`FigureQueue._request_pdf_refinement` detects the missing page and stops waiting for it.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue.render_figure_to_png#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Returns True once the PNG — the raster the GUI actually displays — is on disk. A failed *sibling PDF* does not turn that into False, and the asymmetry is deliberate rather than sloppy: the callers turn False into "no pixmap, no thumbnail", so reporting a missing export that way would delete the figure from the gallery over a file nothing has asked for yet. It is logged at WARNING instead, and :meth:`FigureQueue._request_pdf_refinement` notices the absent page, says so, and stops waiting for a render that will never arrive.

records.source: This fallback supports figures without a ``_spacr_replot`` payload by reading plotted values from bars, scatter collections, and data lines on a single axes. Artist-derived data are exact for bar heights and point coordinates but are necessarily lossy for summary artists such as box or violin plots, which do not retain their source observations. Figures created by :func:`spacr.plot.create_grouped_plot` use their attached source frame instead of this fallback.

Every run from that file was then refused by the pre-flight -- "column_csv=[...] is a list, but str is expected" -- against a value the user had never typed and could not correct from the panel that wrote it.
records.translation: 这一区别并非表面文章。``grna_csv``、``row_csv`` 和 ``column_csv`` 被声明为 ``str``，并直接传给 ``pd.read_csv``，因此一旦打开并保存该界面，把它们渲染成列表就会把可用的默认值变成 ``['/path/to/barcodes_row.csv']``。此后基于该文件的每次运行都会被运行前检查拒绝 -- "column_csv=[...] is a list, but str is expected" -- 而这个值用户从未输入过，也无法在写入它的面板中更正。

The node count and nesting depth are capped as well (:data:`MAX_NODES`, :data:`MAX_DEPTH`), so a pathological expression is refused at parse time rather than during a redraw.
records.translation: 数字始终按 **浮点数** 读取：用 Python 整数计算 ``9 ** 9 ** 9`` 需要花数秒为一个有 3 亿位的数字分配内存 — 只需输入十一个字符就能造成拒绝服务 — 而用浮点数计算只需一纳秒就得到 ``inf``。节点数和嵌套深度也设有上限（:data:`MAX_NODES`、:data:`MAX_DEPTH`），因此病态表达式会在解析时被拒绝，而不是在重绘时。

records.source: The grammar deliberately omits five things, each of which would allow an attack or cause confusion:
records.translation: 该语法有意省略了五样东西，其中每一样都可能导致攻击或引起混淆：

records.context: **no string literals** — so no payload can be smuggled through as data, and the language has nothing to feed to a function that might want a name;
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **no string literals** — so no payload can be smuggled through as data, and the language has nothing to feed to a function that might want a name;
records.translation: **没有字符串字面量** — 因此无法以数据的形式夹带任何载荷，语言中也没有任何东西可以传给可能需要名称的函数；

records.context: **no attribute access, no indexing, no assignment** — ``.``, ``[`` and a bare ``=`` are rejected by the tokeniser with the reason, so the ``().__class__.__bases__`` ladder does not get as far as the parser;
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **no attribute access, no indexing, no assignment** — ``.``, ``[`` and a bare ``=`` are rejected by the tokeniser with the reason, so the ``().__class__.__bases__`` ladder does not get as far as the parser;
records.translation: **没有属性访问、没有索引、没有赋值** — ``.``、``[`` 以及单独的 ``=`` 会被词法分析器拒绝并给出原因，因此 ``().__class__.__bases__`` 这类逐级攀爬连解析器都到不了；

records.context: **no lambdas, no comprehensions, no statements** — an expression evaluates to one column and nothing else;
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **no lambdas, no comprehensions, no statements** — an expression evaluates to one column and nothing else;
records.translation: **没有 lambda、没有推导式、没有语句** — 一个表达式只求值为一列，别无其他；

records.context: **no arbitrary names** — a name is either a column of the frame or one of :data:`FUNCTIONS`. ``__import__``, ``open`` and ``eval`` are not blocked as special cases; they are not columns, and the error says so;
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **no arbitrary names** — a name is either a column of the frame or one of :data:`FUNCTIONS`. ``__import__``, ``open`` and ``eval`` are not blocked as special cases; they are not columns, and the error says so;
records.translation: **没有任意名称** — 名称要么是数据框中的列，要么是 :data:`FUNCTIONS` 之一。``__import__``、``open`` 和 ``eval`` 并没有作为特例被屏蔽；它们不是列，错误信息也会如此说明；

records.context: **comparisons do not chain** — ``0 < area < 5`` is refused rather than silently parsed as something numpy would evaluate elementwise into a shape nobody meant. The message says to write the conjunction.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **comparisons do not chain** — ``0 < area < 5`` is refused rather than silently parsed as something numpy would evaluate elementwise into a shape nobody meant. The message says to write the conjunction.
records.translation: **比较不能链式书写** — ``0 < area < 5`` 会被拒绝，而不是被悄悄解析成 numpy 会逐元素求值、得到无人想要的形状的东西。错误信息会提示改写为合取形式。

records.context: Two rules apply to what the preview reports.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.motility_preview#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Two rules apply to what the preview reports.
records.translation: 预览所报告的内容遵循两条规则。

records.context: **Units.** The assay converts pixels per frame into physical units with ``factor = (1 / pixels_per_um) * (60 / seconds_per_frame)`` and only when *both* are known; otherwise it reports ``px/frame``. So that a velocity is never read in the wrong unit, the calibration fields start **unset**, every velocity carries its unit, and while the calibration is unknown the panel says so in words instead of silently using the 1.78 px/µm default.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.motility_preview#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Units.** The assay converts pixels per frame into physical units with ``factor = (1 / pixels_per_um) * (60 / seconds_per_frame)`` and only when *both* are known; otherwise it reports ``px/frame``. So that a velocity is never read in the wrong unit, the calibration fields start **unset**, every velocity carries its unit, and while the calibration is unknown the panel says so in words instead of silently using the 1.78 px/µm default.
records.translation: **单位。** 该测定使用 ``factor = (1 / pixels_per_um) * (60 / seconds_per_frame)`` 将每帧像素数换算为物理单位，并且只在两者 *都* 已知时才换算；否则报告 ``px/frame``。为避免以错误单位解读速度，校准字段初始为 **未设置**，每个速度都带有单位，并且在校准未知时，面板会用文字说明这一点，而不是悄悄使用 1.78 px/µm 的默认值。

records.context: **Short tracks.** Mean step length and straightness are unstable on a three-point track — straightness is exactly 1.0 for any two-point track, whatever the cell did. So the track-length distribution is drawn beside the velocity plot with the cutoff marked, and the minimum length is a live setting that decides which tracks enter the velocity and straightness numbers.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.motility_preview#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Short tracks.** Mean step length and straightness are unstable on a three-point track — straightness is exactly 1.0 for any two-point track, whatever the cell did. So the track-length distribution is drawn beside the velocity plot with the cutoff marked, and the minimum length is a live setting that decides which tracks enter the velocity and straightness numbers.
records.translation: **短轨迹。** 对于只有三个点的轨迹，平均步长和直线度都不稳定 — 任何两点轨迹的直线度都恰好为 1.0，无论细胞实际如何运动。因此轨迹长度分布会绘制在速度图旁边并标出截断值，最小长度是一个实时设置，决定哪些轨迹纳入速度和直线度的统计。

records.context: Why the scores plot is a GraphCanvas
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_view#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Why the scores plot is a GraphCanvas
records.translation: 为什么得分图是一个 GraphCanvas

records.context: A PCA scores plot is a scatter of two continuous columns that a user wants to colour by ``gene``, facet by ``plateID``, and brush to pull a cluster into Annotate. That is the Graph Builder, exactly, with the two columns computed rather than measured. So :meth:`PCAResult.scores_frame <spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.scores_frame>` appends ``PC1…PCk`` to the source frame and :class:`PCAScoresCanvas` is a :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` subclass that draws arrows on top.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_view#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A PCA scores plot is a scatter of two continuous columns that a user wants to colour by ``gene``, facet by ``plateID``, and brush to pull a cluster into Annotate. That is the Graph Builder, exactly, with the two columns computed rather than measured. So :meth:`PCAResult.scores_frame <spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.scores_frame>` appends ``PC1…PCk`` to the source frame and :class:`PCAScoresCanvas` is a :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` subclass that draws arrows on top.
records.translation: PCA 得分图是两个连续列的散点图，用户希望按 ``gene`` 着色、按 ``plateID`` 分面，并通过框选把一个簇拉入 Annotate。这恰好就是 Graph Builder，只是这两列是计算出来的而不是测量得到的。因此 :meth:`PCAResult.scores_frame <spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.scores_frame>` 会把 ``PC1…PCk`` 追加到源数据框中，而 :class:`PCAScoresCanvas` 是 :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` 的子类，只在其上额外绘制箭头。

records.context: Everything that took work in the Graph Builder therefore already works here and cannot drift out of step with it: the shared-scale facet grid, the fixed categorical colour order, the large-data policy and its notice, the selection-dims-never-hides rule, and the brush. Because the scores frame carries the object identifier columns, a rectangle dragged around a cluster in PC space publishes a real :class:`~spacr.selection.Selection`, and the UMAP, the laboratory microplate map and the extracted-image-region grid highlight the same cells. Reimplementing a scatter here would have meant reimplementing all of that and getting the brush subtly wrong.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_view#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Everything that took work in the Graph Builder therefore already works here and cannot drift out of step with it: the shared-scale facet grid, the fixed categorical colour order, the large-data policy and its notice, the selection-dims-never-hides rule, and the brush. Because the scores frame carries the object key columns, a rectangle dragged around a cluster in PC space publishes a real :class:`~spacr.selection.Selection`, and the UMAP, the plate map and the crop grid highlight the same cells. Reimplementing a scatter here would have meant reimplementing all of that and getting the brush subtly wrong.
records.translation: 因此，在 Graph Builder 中费心实现的一切在这里都已可用，也不会与之脱节：共享刻度的分面网格、固定的分类颜色顺序、大数据策略及其提示、选择只调暗而绝不隐藏的规则，以及框选。由于得分数据框带有对象键列，在 PC 空间中围绕一个簇拖出的矩形会发布一个真实的 :class:`~spacr.selection.Selection`，UMAP、板图和裁剪网格会高亮相同的细胞。如果在这里重新实现散点图，就意味着要重新实现上述全部功能，而且很可能在框选上出现细微错误。

records.context: Rows and columns are the **cartesian product** of their structured-data names' levels, empty combinations included, exactly as :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.facet_grid` draws empty panels: a table read by position needs its positions to line up, and one that closes up its gaps tells the reader "there is no row H" when the truth is "row H was measured and is empty". Above :data:`MAX_ROWS` × :data:`MAX_COLS` the product is abandoned for the observed combinations only, and :attr:`PivotResult.notice` says so — an unreadable table is not more honest than a smaller one that admits what it left out.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pivot_spec#10
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Rows and columns are the **cartesian product** of their keys' levels, empty combinations included, exactly as :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.facet_grid` draws empty panels: a table read by position needs its positions to line up, and one that closes up its gaps tells the reader "there is no row H" when the truth is "row H was measured and is empty". Above :data:`MAX_ROWS` × :data:`MAX_COLS` the product is abandoned for the observed combinations only, and :attr:`PivotResult.notice` says so — an unreadable table is not more honest than a smaller one that admits what it left out.
records.translation: 行和列是其键水平的 **笛卡尔积**，包括空组合，正如 :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.facet_grid` 会绘制空面板一样：按位置阅读的表格需要各位置对齐，而一张合并了空缺的表格会告诉读者 "there is no row H"（没有 H 行），而真相是 "row H was measured and is empty"（H 行已测量但为空）。超过 :data:`MAX_ROWS` × :data:`MAX_COLS` 时，会放弃笛卡尔积而只使用实际观测到的组合，并由 :attr:`PivotResult.notice` 加以说明 — 一张无法阅读的表格，并不比一张承认省略了哪些内容的较小表格更诚实。

records.context: Three of those rows were bugs rather than differences of taste. Measure returned after extracting image regions again without a word when no array was loaded, so the button did nothing and said nothing. Timelapse and Motility wired ``QThread.finished`` to ``worker.deleteLater`` and dropped their own reference in the result slot — the pattern :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` documents as a race, and the one the Mask panel had already been fixed away from — which leaves a running ``QThread`` owned by nobody when the user closes the application view mid-pass. And Measure never told anyone its pass had landed, so no application view could react to an extracted image region preview the way it reacts to the other three.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_contract#56
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three of those rows were bugs rather than differences of taste. Measure returned from its re-crop without a word when no array was loaded, so the button did nothing and said nothing. Timelapse and Motility wired ``QThread.finished`` to ``worker.deleteLater`` and dropped their own reference in the result slot — the pattern :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` documents as a race, and the one the Mask panel had already been fixed away from — which leaves a running ``QThread`` owned by nobody when the user closes the screen mid-pass. And Measure never told anyone its pass had landed, so no screen could react to a crop preview the way it reacts to the other three.
records.translation: 其中三行是程序错误，而不是风格偏好的差异。Measure 在未加载任何数组时会一声不响地从重新裁剪中返回，于是按钮既不起作用也没有任何提示。Timelapse 和 Motility 把 ``QThread.finished`` 连接到 ``worker.deleteLater``，并在结果槽中丢弃了自己的引用 — :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` 将这种模式记录为竞态条件，Mask 面板此前已修复为不再使用它 — 这会导致用户在处理中途关闭界面时，留下一个无人拥有的运行中 ``QThread``。另外，Measure 从不告知任何人其处理已经完成，因此没有界面能像对其他三个那样对裁剪预览作出反应。

records.context: A **live view** is a panel that re-renders the module's own output from the current settings, on real input, before a processing session. That is Mask, Timelapse, Measure and Motility, and it is what the **Live** toggle opens. records.translation: 用于 Image UMAP 搜索结果的原生交互式查看器和画廊。

records.context: Unlike the general spaCR figure list, these widgets hold the coordinate arrays themselves.  A 3-D map can therefore be spun and recoloured after it has been computed, and clicking a gallery tile opens the exact embedding that was scored rather than a PNG or a stochastic refit.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.umap_search_viewer#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Unlike the general spaCR figure queue, these widgets hold the coordinate arrays themselves.  A 3-D map can therefore be spun and recoloured after it has been computed, and clicking a gallery tile opens the exact embedding that was scored rather than a PNG or a stochastic refit.
records.translation: 与通用的 spaCR 图形队列不同，这些部件自己持有坐标数组。因此 3-D 图在计算完成后仍可旋转和重新着色，而点击画廊中的图块会打开当初被评分的那个确切嵌入，而不是一张 PNG 或一次随机的重新拟合。

records.context: The renderer uses Qt's painter only.  It has no OpenGL or pyqtgraph dependency, works in the offscreen test platform, and keeps the RAPIDS extra about compute rather than pulling in a second GUI stack.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The renderer uses Qt's painter only.  It has no OpenGL or pyqtgraph dependency, works in the offscreen test platform, and keeps the RAPIDS extra about compute rather than pulling in a second GUI stack.
